name: @educateos/quizzes
description: EducateOS quizzes (LMS-lite L7, SCHO-191): an offering's item banks and quizzes (multiple choice, multiple select, true/false, numeric with tolerance, short answer, essay) and its students' timed, attempt-limited attempts, decided by the district's policy engine. The server scores every item but essays on submission; scores stay proposals until a teacher releases them as official grades through the assessment gate, as one action. Answer keys never reach a student before the quiz shows them. A library, not a deployable Worker.
